summary.zh: 滴滴车型预估、创建订单、订单与司机位置
summary.en: Didi estimates, order creation, ride status and driver location

description.zh: 在对话里搜索地点、预估车型与价格、创建滴滴订单、查询订单与司机位置；也可生成滴滴 App/小程序发单链接。滴滴 Key 加密保存在本机；支付在滴滴内完成，插件不会自动支付。
description.en: Search places, estimate ride options and fares, create Didi orders, and check orders and driver locations from chat; also generate Didi app or mini program booking links. The Didi key is stored encrypted on this device; payment happens in Didi and the plugin never pays automatically.
